events.info: After Dark Presents Emo Night Syracuse Emo Night Syracuse is the ultimate emo night party at The Song & Dance in Syracuse, NY. Hosted by After Dark Presents, the concert promoter that has booked the biggest emo bands for decades! this night delivers the perfect mix of a high-energy concert and an all-out party. We have themed drinks, non-stop singalongs, and a DJ spinning all the anthems and deep cuts. As one patron put it, Emo Night Syracuse is , "rdquo" -> definitely the most fun I've ever had at any Emo Night." Whether you're screaming along to My Chemical Romance, dancing to Fall Out Boy, or throwing it back with Taking Back Sunday, Emo Night Syracuse is where every emo kid feels at home. events.name: Theresa Caputo Live! The Experience
events.info: For more than a decade, Theresa Caputo-known worldwide as the Long Island Medium-has touched the lives of millions of fans, comforting supporters when they need it most. Through personal life stories, candid humor, and intimate details about her gift to communicate with those who have passed on, the beloved television personality and best-selling author delivers healing messages to her audience, reassuring them with the revelation that their deceased loved ones are still with them-just in a different way. Recognized as one of the most renowned mediums for over 20 years, Theresa Caputo Live: The Experience is the awe-inspiring event you won't want to miss.
